provenance.construction: Published cyclic toric family of Alexey A. Kovalev, Ilya Dumer, and Leonid P. Pryadko (2011), Example 11. Set t=19, d=2t+1=39, n=t^2+(t+1)^2=761. Generator i has X on {i+t,i+t+1} mod n and Z on {i,i+d} mod n. The affine relabelling q -> 2t*q+(2t+2) mod n maps the seed to X on {1,d}, Z on {0,d+1}, the published ZX I^(2t-1) XZ generator.
provenance.notes: Reproduction of a known family, not a new construction or new parameters. The submission distance remains a witness-backed upper bound because the challenge does not certify non-CSS distances. Explicit logical: X on {t}, Z on {0,...,d-1}. Commutation and nontriviality are checked by the trusted verifier; odd X parity establishes nontriviality since every stabilizer generator has even X parity. No locality layout is claimed.
